name: x402 Carbon Retirement API
description: Retire tokenized carbon credits on Base through Klima Protocol and the Carbonmark marketplace, and resolve the public Carbonmark certificate. Discovery, quotes and certificates are free. Retiring is paid: each retirement costs the credit price plus a fee, sent from your own wallet (GET /api/prepare/retire) or funded by a signed authorization and relayed non-custodially (POST /api/actions/retire, which adds executor gas). GET /api/catalog is a $0.001 x402 snapshot of the most liquid supply.
